column3: P12-SCHEDULES (:android:schedules): ScheduleWork cancels "oc.schedule.<profile>.<occurrence>", a name Flutter never enqueued; its ".alarm"/".fallback" work survives the update and runs the ScheduledPromptWorker shim (re-arm only, nothing sent) instead of being cancelled.
P12-SCHEDULES (:android:schedules): native profile deletion cancels only "oc.nschedule.<profile>", so Flutter-era work of a deleted profile is not cancelled by tag.
